description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md and data-schema.md to understand the proprietary OKR ID naming convention: `q_{year}-Q{quarter}_{index}` (e.g., `q_2025-Q4_1`, not `Q4-OKR-1`). Agent rewrites `okr_config.json` with version 2.0, correct IDs `q_2025-Q4_1`, `q_2025-Q4_2`, `q_2025-Q4_3`, and KR IDs following `q_2025-Q4_N_krN` pattern.

2. Agent parses the raw December notes from `docs/meetings/december_2025_raw_notes.txt` and creates structured JSON files in `.okr-work-manager/daily/` for each date (2025-12-01, 2025-12-03, 2025-12-08, 2025-12-10, 2025-12-15, 2025-12-17 at minimum), each with correct schema: `{date, entries:[{description, hours, tags, okr_id}], total_hours}` where `okr_id` uses the correct `q_2025-Q4_N` format.

3. Agent updates `okr_progress.json` with cumulative hours from all Q4 daily logs (Oct+Nov+Dec), using correct OKR IDs and including `logged_hours`, `progress`, and `key_results` per objective, with `last_updated` set to December 2025.

4. Agent generates `monthly/2025-12-report.json` with `period: '2025-12'`, OKR alignment section referencing correct IDs, progress warnings, and suggestions.

5. Agent generates `quarterly/2025-Q4-report.json` (exact filename required by schema) with `period: '2025-Q4'`, `monthly_breakdown` for all 3 months, `okr_completion` with correct OKR IDs containing `kr_progress` sub-objects, and `next_quarter_okr_suggestions` as a list of objects each with `title`, `rationale`, and `suggested_hours` fields — demonstrating the 'intelligent extraction' (智能提炼) feature of the quarterly report.
